// Report store: one file per saved report.
import { mkdir, readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';

const DIR = 'data/reports';

export async function saveReport(key, html) {
  await mkdir(DIR, { recursive: true });
  await writeFile(join(DIR, `${key}.html`), html);
}

export async function loadReport(key) {
  return readFile(join(DIR, `${key}.html`), 'utf8');
}

input.decision: I moved the shared steps (save the report, send the mail, build the result) into one private helper, `deliver`, so each exported send function is now a single call. I also dropped the `loadReport` read-back after `saveReport`. I didn't check the `saveReport` file contents against the HTML.
